hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf %s "$in" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // \"\""); case "$f" in */app/*.py) body=$(printf %s "$in" | jq -r ".tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // \"\""); if printf %s "$body" | grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*(import|from)[[:space:]]+(requests|httpx|aiohttp|urllib3|urllib\\.request|http\\.client|websockets|openai|anthropic|boto3|botocore|google\\.cloud|azure|deepl|googletrans)\\b"; then echo "Blocked: network/cloud client import in app/. This project is local-only (see CLAUDE.md); only scripts/download_models.py may use the network." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path"); case "$f" in *.py) root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; py="$root/armtranscribe/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$py" ] || exit 0; cd "$root/armtranscribe" && out=$("$py" -m pytest -q -x 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; };; esac
